name: Deepgram
summary: Speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agent APIs.
description: Deepgram gives developers fast, accurate transcription APIs for real-time or recorded audio, plus text-to-speech and a voice agent API. They're used for call centers, assistants and meeting tools.

howToUse.title: Open Deepgram
howToUse.description: Go to Deepgram and sign up. New accounts receive $200 of credit without a card.

howToUse.title: Call the speech APIs
howToUse.description: Call the speech-to-text, text-to-speech and voice agent APIs that Deepgram provides. Flux models are designed for conversation, with handling for turn-taking and interruptions.

howToUse.title: Pick pay-as-you-go or a commitment
howToUse.description: After the credit, usage is billed pay-as-you-go and there are no minimums. Growth plans start once annual commitments are in place, and the enterprise offering is custom. The products are offered as APIs for developers and as enterprise deployments.

features_fr: Transcription rapide en temps réel et sur fichiers
summary_fr: API de reconnaissance vocale, synthèse vocale et agents vocaux.
description_fr: Deepgram fournit aux développeurs des API de transcription rapides et précises, en temps réel ou sur fichiers, ainsi que de la synthèse vocale et une API pour créer des agents vocaux. Elles sont utilisées pour les centres d'appels, les assistants et les outils de réunion.
